team_review.withCheck: "shift_reports"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid and nullif(current_setting('app.team_scope', true), '') in ('owner', 'agency') and "shift_reports"."status" in ('validated', 'rejected') and "shift_reports"."reviewed_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and not exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = "shift_reports"."member_id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) and (nullif(current_setting('app.team_scope', true), '') = 'owner' or "shift_reports"."submitted_by" <> nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''))

shift_reports_amount_check.name: shift_reports_amount_check
shift_reports_amount_check.value: "shift_reports"."amount_minor" between -5000000 and 5000000 and case when "shift_reports"."corrects_id" is null then "shift_reports"."amount_minor" >= 0 else "shift_reports"."amount_minor" <> 0 end

shift_reports_texts_check.name: shift_reports_texts_check
shift_reports_texts_check.value: coalesce(char_length("shift_reports"."comment"), 1) between 1 and 1000 and coalesce(char_length("shift_reports"."incident"), 1) between 1 and 1000 and coalesce(char_length("shift_reports"."review_note"), 1) between 1 and 500

shift_reports_state_check.name: shift_reports_state_check
shift_reports_state_check.value: ("shift_reports"."reviewed_at" is null) = ("shift_reports"."reviewed_by" is null) and ("shift_reports"."status" = 'submitted') = ("shift_reports"."reviewed_at" is null) and ("shift_reports"."status" = 'rejected') = ("shift_reports"."review_note" is not null)

swap_read.name: swap_read
swap_read.using: ("shift_swap_requests"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid or "shift_swap_requests"."target_creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid) and (nullif(current_setting('app.team_scope', true), '') in ('owner', 'agency') or exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = "shift_swap_requests"."requester_id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) or exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = "shift_swap_requests"."target_member_id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')))

requester_insert.name: requester_insert
requester_insert.withCheck: "shift_swap_requests"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid and exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = "shift_swap_requests"."requester_id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) and "shift_swap_requests"."created_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and "shift_swap_requests"."status" = 'proposed'

requester_withdraw.name: requester_withdraw
requester_withdraw.using: ("shift_swap_requests"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid or "shift_swap_requests"."target_creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid) and exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = "shift_swap_requests"."requester_id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) and "shift_swap_requests"."status" = 'proposed'
requester_withdraw.withCheck: exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = "shift_swap_requests"."requester_id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) and "shift_swap_requests"."status" in ('withdrawn', 'lapsed') and "shift_swap_requests"."resolved_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')

target_answer.name: target_answer

target_answer.withCheck: exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = "shift_swap_requests"."target_member_id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) and "shift_swap_requests"."status" in ('accepted', 'declined', 'lapsed') and "shift_swap_requests"."resolved_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')

team_update.name: team_update
team_update.using: ("shift_swap_requests"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid or "shift_swap_requests"."target_creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid) and nullif(current_setting('app.team_scope', true), '') in ('owner', 'agency')
team_update.withCheck: ("shift_swap_requests"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid or "shift_swap_requests"."target_creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid) and nullif(current_setting('app.team_scope', true), '') in ('owner', 'agency') and (("shift_swap_requests"."status" in ('withdrawn', 'lapsed') and "shift_swap_requests"."resolved_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) or ("shift_swap_requests"."status" = 'reverted' and "shift_swap_requests"."reverted_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')))

shift_swap_requests_state_check.name: shift_swap_requests_state_check
shift_swap_requests_state_check.value: ("shift_swap_requests"."resolved_by" is null or "shift_swap_requests"."resolved_at" is not null) and ("shift_swap_requests"."resolved_by" is not null or "shift_swap_requests"."status" in ('proposed', 'lapsed')) and ("shift_swap_requests"."reverted_at" is null) = ("shift_swap_requests"."reverted_by" is null) and ("shift_swap_requests"."status" = 'proposed') = ("shift_swap_requests"."resolved_at" is null) and ("shift_swap_requests"."status" = 'reverted') = ("shift_swap_requests"."reverted_at" is not null)

swap_read.name: swap_read
swap_read.using: "shifts"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid and exists (select 1 from shift_swap_requests s where (s.shift_id = "shifts"."id" or s.target_shift_id = "shifts"."id") and s.status in ('proposed', 'accepted') and (exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = s.requester_id and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) or exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = s.target_member_id and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''))))

swap_update.name: swap_update
swap_update.using: "shifts"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid and exists (select 1 from shift_swap_requests s where s.status = 'accepted' and s.resolved_at = now() and exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = s.target_member_id and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) and (s.shift_id = "shifts"."id" or s.target_shift_id = "shifts"."id"))
swap_update.withCheck: "shifts"."creator_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.creator_id', true), '')::uuid and "shifts"."updated_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and "shifts"."cancelled_at" is null and "shifts"."stopped_at" is null and exists (select 1 from shift_swap_requests s where s.status = 'accepted' and s.resolved_at = now() and exists (select 1 from team_members m where m.id = s.target_member_id and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')) and ((s.shift_id = "shifts"."id" and "shifts"."member_id" = s.target_member_id and "shifts"."starts_at" = s.shift_starts_at and "shifts"."ends_at" = s.shift_ends_at) or (s.target_shift_id = "shifts"."id" and "shifts"."member_id" = s.requester_id and "shifts"."starts_at" = s.target_shift_starts_at and "shifts"."ends_at" = s.target_shift_ends_at)))
